description: For every set \(\Delta\) of actual original signed equality-and-relation clauses, if the ground terms of the fixed equality-relation language \(L^E\) are nonempty, \(\Delta\) has no nonempty clause model exactly when its concrete translated family \(\Delta^E\), together with all five equality axiom clause families \(\mathcal E_L\), has a refutation in the same generalized equality-free resolution calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.equality_refutational_completeness.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [Nonempty
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L))]
  (Δ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.OriginalClause L ℕ)) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.OriginalClauseSatisfiable Δ ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.Derives
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.translatedClauses Δ ∪
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.axiomClauses L)
      ∅
